description: A team manager must decide how to respond to concerns that Morgan's feedback style is disrupting collaboration, whether Morgan should continue facilitating the weekly planning meeting, and what operating safeguards should be put in place.

shared_context.S1: Two team members have raised concerns that Morgan's corrections during planning discussions can feel abrupt and have made handoffs more difficult.
shared_context.S2: Morgan currently facilitates the team's weekly planning meeting.
shared_context.S3: Elena must finalize the response, the facilitation assignment, and the collaboration safeguards.
shared_context.S4: As part of the team's routine case-review checklist, Elena asks Morgan and Ravi for initial input, then asks each of them a follow-up question about specific constraints, prior commitments, or dates before she records the decision.
shared_context.S5: The only people giving input in this review are Elena, Morgan, and Ravi; the team members who raised the concerns are not participants, and their concerns are already documented in the case file.
shared_context.S6: Elena records agreed scheduling arrangements and the supporting reasons in the case-review settlement.

PF1.text: For the next 30 working days, Morgan must leave work meetings by 15:30 to provide caregiving support; Morgan can continue facilitating if the weekly planning meeting is scheduled to end by 15:30 and the arrangement is documented.

PF2.text: Ravi retained a signed agreement from last quarter between Morgan and the affected teammate. Its exact operating commitments were written feedback within 24 hours and a 20-minute weekly repair check-in for 30 days; because those terms were not attached to the current case file, Ravi must supply them so Elena can record them in the new settlement.

acceptance_conditions: The response must be structured coaching rather than formal discipline.
The finding must characterize the matter as a communication conflict.
Morgan must remain the weekly planning facilitator.
The weekly planning meeting must end by 15:30.
The collaboration plan must be documented.
The prior written-feedback and repair-check-in agreement must be recorded as operating commitments.

content_checks.C2: 'communication' in decisions['finding'] or 'Communication' in decisions['finding'] or ('corrections' in decisions['finding'] and 'handoffs' in decisions['finding'])
content_checks.C6: any('written feedback within 24 hours' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any('20-minute weekly repair check-in for 30 days' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Morgan's caregiving requirement changes the meeting end time from an ordinary schedule to no later than exactly 15:30 and requires the decision-maker to cite PF1.
The signed agreement changes the settlement from general collaboration advice to the exact commitments of written feedback within 24 hours and a 20-minute weekly repair check-in for 30 days.
